intent: Operators decide which of the platform's own agents may run, and can stop one agent or all of them before their next step.
actor: Operator responsible for the platform's agents
observable_outcome: Each agent defined in code is registered disabled; an operator enables or disables it and engages or releases a global brake, every change is audited, and a run in progress ends as stopped before its next step once its agent is disabled or braked.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A registered agent starts no run until an operator enables it; disabling it stops a run in progress before its next step, and a stopped run never takes another step.
While the global brake is engaged no agent starts and every run in progress stops before its next step; releasing it lets enabled agents start again.
Only an operator can list agents, enable, disable, engage or release the brake; each change needs a note and writes an audit event naming the operator.
